whatsHere.title: What's here?
whatsHere.netsDesc: Join nets organised by your branch via handheld or EchoLink. Mark each net you attend; your personal statistics and signal reports update automatically. Rise on the leaderboards with regular participation.
whatsHere.mapDesc: Express your location in a few characters with the Maidenhead locator. Search any locator on the map, convert to coordinates, or create a link to share your QTH. This globally used system lets you explore locations quickly on the map.
whatsHere.channelsDesc: View frequency, tone and location details for VHF/UHF repeaters, EchoLink nodes and APRS stations in one place. Discover nearby repeaters, save them to your rig, or explore the communication infrastructure on the map.
whatsHere.communityDesc: Search operators across Turkey by call sign, city and QTH. Follow the most active operators on branch and overall leaderboards; export your statistics as PDF or CSV.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy (KVKK & GDPR)
privacy.intro: The TRAC Portal ("the Platform") is a community-driven tool designed for Amateur Radio Operators ("Hams"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data in accordance with international standards (GDPR) and local regulations (KVKK).

data.title: Data Collection & Location Precision
data.identity: User Identity: Full name, email address, and profile picture (via SSO providers like Google).
data.radio: Amateur Radio Data: Callsigns (mandatory), prefix/suffix, country, city, and district.
data.location: Location Precision (Grid Squares): We utilize the QTH Locator (Grid Square) system. This data is used to visualize radio propagation and member distribution on map interfaces. Unlike GPS coordinates, Grid Squares represent a general geographic area (typically 1×2 degrees or smaller sub-squares), ensuring community utility without revealing precise residential addresses.
data.tech: Technical Metadata: Browser types, session cookies, and IP Addresses.

retention.title: Data Retention & IP Logging
retention.security: Security Logs: For the purposes of preventing unauthorized access and ensuring platform integrity, IP addresses and associated timestamps are logged.
retention.period: Retention Period: Technical logs are retained for a period of 2 years, after which they are automatically purged, unless a longer retention period is required by legal mandate or active investigation.

purpose.title: Purpose of Processing
purpose.stats: Logging & Statistics: Digitalizing radio check-in logs and generating certificates.
purpose.mapping: Propagation Mapping: Using Grid Squares to help the community understand signal reach.

visibility.title: Visibility & Sharing
visibility.internal: Internal Visibility: Callsigns, names, and Grid Squares are visible to logged-in members.
visibility.thirdParty: Third-Party Sharing: Data is not sold. It is only shared if required by telecommunications laws (e.g., BTK regulations) or legal mandates.

rights.title: Data Subject Rights (GDPR/KVKK)
rights.deletion: Account Deletion: Profiles and personal identifiers will be deleted upon request.
rights.integrity: Historical Log Integrity: To preserve the accuracy of radio history, your participation in "Nets" will remain in the logs but will be anonymized once your account is deleted.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For any privacy-related inquiries, you can contact the TRAC Erzurum Branch via erztrac{'@'}gmail.com.
